dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, next question: how do solar panels work?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈnɛkst ˈkwɛstʃən: ˈhaʊ duː ˈsoʊlər ˈpænəlz ˈwɜːrk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They produce electricity by using light from the sun.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ prəˈduːs ɪˌlɛkˈtrɪsəti baɪ ˈjuːzɪŋ ˈlaɪt frəm ðə ˈsʌn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Correct. How can you keep fish or fruit for a long time without a fridge?
dialogue.reading: kəˈrɛkt. ˈhaʊ kən juː ˈkiːp ˈfɪʃ ɔːr ˈfruːt fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm wɪˈðaʊt ə ˈfrɪdʒ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: By drying them in the sun. It's a very old process.
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈdraɪɪŋ ðɛm ɪn ðə ˈsʌn. ɪts ə ˈvɛri ˈoʊld ˈprɑːsɛs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good. How does the city's water system make water safe to drink?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd. ˈhaʊ dʌz ðə ˈsɪtiz ˈwɔːtər ˈsɪstəm ˈmeɪk ˈwɔːtər ˈseɪf tə ˈdrɪŋk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: By cleaning it and adding some chemicals.
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈkliːnɪŋ ɪt ənd ˈædɪŋ sʌm ˈkɛmɪkəlz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Right. Now, your opinion: which invention is the most important?
dialogue.reading: ˈraɪt. ˈnaʊ, jʊr əˈpɪnjən: ˈwɪtʃ ɪnˈvɛnʃən ɪz ðə ˈmoʊst ɪmˈpɔːrtənt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The washing machine! It saves people hours of work every week.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈwɑːʃɪŋ məˌʃiːn! ɪt ˈseɪvz ˈpiːpəl ˈaʊərz əv ˈwɜːrk ˈɛvri ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Computers are great, but washing machines gave people more time to study and work.
dialogue.reading: kəmˈpjuːtərz ər ˈɡreɪt, bʌt ˈwɑːʃɪŋ məˌʃiːnz ˈɡeɪv ˈpiːpəl ˈmɔːr ˈtaɪm tə ˈstʌdi ənd ˈwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good answer, Nam. You'll do well on the quiz!
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd ˈænsər, ˈnɑːm. juːl ˈduː ˈwɛl ɑːn ðə ˈkwɪz!
